_nota: F07: inglés de los textos de data/ (nombres, descripciones, misiones, diálogos). Clave = texto español tal cual está en los datos. Los topónimos panameños se dejan como nombres propios. tests/i18nContent.test.ts exige que no falte ninguno.
Combatiente de primera línea que mezcla: Front-line fighter who mixes steel, fire and earth. Starts with a charge, an area strike and an easy-to-read buff.
Hechicera que alterna rayo y escarcha a: Sorceress who alternates lightning and frost at range. Starts with a projectile, a control area and a buff; learns movement spells and zones as she levels up.
Lo que te mantiene en pie. Cada derrota: What keeps you standing. Each defeat takes a part of it; at 0 you die. It refills slowly.
Estás muerto: busca un Alzador para revi: You are dead: find a Raiser to come back.
Heavy and slow, but it splits whatever it hits.
Madera vieja que guarda escarcha en la v: Old wood that keeps frost in its grain.
Chisporrotea al agitarla; dispara pequeñ: It crackles when shaken and fires small shocks.
Una esfera de cristal con una tormenta d: A glass sphere with a storm inside.
Keeps off the sun and the branches.
Tanned leather with plenty of pockets.
Juncos trenzados que sostienen el tobill: Braided reeds that brace the ankle: crowd control lasts less on you.
Blue cloth that bristles with static.
Light; they leave sparks with every step.
Stitched layers of linen; better than nothing.
They guard the forearm when blocking.
Worn down by a thousand roads.
A small shield for the free hand.
Un aro sencillo que guarda algo de fuerz: A plain band that holds a bit of strength.
Green stone, cold to the touch.
A fang tied on a cord.
Heals a good amount at once.
Un trago de seco con raíz amarga. Se te: A shot of seco with bitter root. Your sight blurs and you wake beside the last Painted Stone you touched.
Caldo espeso de raíz roja. Devuelve puls: Thick red-root broth. Restores pulse (energy) when used; it does not heal wounds.
Unos segundos de pies ligeros y mente rá: A few seconds of light feet and a quick mind.
Teaches (or improves) Frost Shard. It can be learned at any level; it goes on the bar from level 5.
Teaches (or improves) Echo of the Moment.
Enseña (o mejora) Polvo vidente: revela: Teaches (or improves) Seeing Dust: reveals nearby hidden traps.
Invoca al zorro de ceniza, que lucha a t: Summons the ash fox, who fights at your side.
Invoca al búho archivero, que recoge el: Summons the archivist owl, who picks up loot for you.
Invoca a la tortuga de musgo, que te reg: Summons the moss turtle, who heals and protects you.
Material for the loom and the anvil.
Material para un futuro oficio; vibra le: Material for a future profession; it hums faintly.
Stubborn, but it knows every trail.
Slow of spirit and thick of hide.
Runs like someone owes it money.
Solo para desarrollo: tucán rechoncho de: Development only: a chubby big-billed toucan; fly with Tab.
Solo para desarrollo: ave corredora de c: Development only: a running bird with a forked crest and steady flight.
Solo para desarrollo: vuela bajo y no se: Development only: flies low and never tires.
Wood for the anvil and the workshop.
Madera dura y pesada; se talla con ofici: Hard, heavy wood; it takes skill to carve.
Raw iron from the high veins.
A dry leaf that can be braided.
Soft; it needs a steady hand at the loom.
Pez común del estanque. Asada sabe a poc: A common pond fish. Grilled it tastes of little, but it fills you up.
Gorda y lenta; dicen que vive desde ante: Fat and slow; they say it has lived here since before the village.
Da calambre al tocarla. Comerla despeja: It shocks you when touched. Eating it clears the head.
Brilla en la oscuridad del fondo. Sólo p: It glows in the dark depths. It bites only now and then, and it is worth a fortune.
Llave de hierro oxidado que abre la reja: A rusty iron key that opens the gate of the Tulivieja Crypt. It is used up on entry: the gate swallows it.
Sólo pica de noche, cuando el charco ref: It bites only at night, when the pond mirrors the moon. Grilled, it takes away weariness.
Sale a comer cuando todos duermen. Tiene: It comes out to feed while everyone sleeps. It looks like it hasn't slept in years.
Alguien la perdió hace mucho. Ni para el: Someone lost it long ago. Not even the smith wants it.
Para abrir trocha… y lo que se ponga por: For clearing trails… and whatever gets in the way.
Pequeño, rápido y con olor a naranja. Va: Small, quick and smelling of oranges. Good in the other hand.
Wood so hard the axe bounces off.
Tensa como cuerda de violín criollo. Len: Taut as a country fiddle string. Slow, but it reaches far.
Media totuma con correa. Para el golpe y: Half a gourd with a strap. It stops blows and doubles as a cup.
A wide brim against the savanna sun.
Fibra trenzada a mano; aprieta pero no f: Hand-braided fiber; tight, but it never fails.
Not very warm, but the rain slides off.
Envuelto en hoja y todavía tibio. Cura p: Wrapped in a leaf and still warm. Slowly heals what hunger leaves behind.
Dulce de caña en bloque. Un mordisco y v: A block of cane sugar. One bite and your spirits return.
Dos palmos más largo que cualquier mache: Two hands longer than any decent machete. It is swung with both hands.
Trenzado de junco y pita, con sus vuelta: Braided from reed and pita, with every turn carefully counted.
Blanca, fresca y con alforzas. Aguanta e: White, cool and pleated. It stands up to the sweat of the bush.
Suela de cuero crudo. Hechas para pisar: Rawhide soles. Made to walk through mud without complaint.
El mangle no se deja cortar; esta hacha: The mangrove won't be cut; this axe won't be forgotten.
Conchas cosidas sobre cuero. Suenan como: Shells sewn onto leather. They rattle like maracas when you run.
Raíz que creció en agua salada; escupe e: A root that grew in salt water; it spits frost.
Roja oscura y espesa. Cierra heridas que: Dark red and thick. It closes wounds the minor one won't even look at.
Piedrita brillante que los cangrejos gua: A shiny pebble that crabs hoard without knowing why.
Cartón, pintura y cuernos. Quien la llev: Cardboard, paint and horns. Whoever wears it dances faster than they think.
Rayas rojas y negras que marean al que m: Red and black stripes that make onlookers dizzy.
Every step rings; so does every blow.
Para la otra mano del baile. Arde un poq: For the other hand in the dance. It burns a little.
Martillo del beneficio de café. Muele gr: A hammer from the coffee mill. It grinds beans, and not only beans.
Asta fina con plumas verdes. Pica como e: A slender shaft with green feathers. It strikes like lightning through the mist.
Para coger café en la ladera sin dejarse: For picking coffee on the slope without losing your fingers.
Cafecito de altura con la llovizna de la: Highland coffee with the afternoon drizzle. Light feet and a wide-awake mind.
Flores de nácar que tiemblan con cada he: Mother-of-pearl flowers that tremble with every spell.
Meses de bordado a mano. Se lleva con or: Months of hand embroidery. Worn with pride and kept like a treasure.
Flat gold, the kind grandma had.
Raso con hebilla. Para el tamborito, no: Satin with a buckle. For the tamborito, not for the mud.
Por dentro siempre son las seis de la ma: Inside, it is always six in the morning in Cerro Punta.
La tapa de la olla del sancocho. Abollad: The lid of the sancocho pot. Dented, but honest.
Half the farm is stuck to their soles.
Templada en una grieta del Barú. Todavía: Tempered in a crack of the Barú. It still smokes on cold nights.
Piedra negra pulida a fuerza de pacienci: Black stone polished by sheer patience.
Ceniza del volcán que nunca se calentó d: Volcanic ash that never quite warmed up.
Desde la cumbre se ven los dos mares; co: From the summit you can see both oceans; with this one you can reach them.
Hilada con la nube que se agarra a la ci: Spun from the cloud that clings to the peak at dawn.
Madera roja que no se raja ni en la selv: Red wood that won't split even in the wettest jungle.
Palm fiber; not even a downpour soaks through.
Dedos libres para soltar la cuerda a tie: Free fingers to release the string in time.
Silent in the mud of the Tuira.
Hojas de bijao cosidas. Huele a tamal re: Sewn bijao leaves. It smells of a fresh tamal.
Espina larga de palma, afilada como mala: A long palm thorn, sharp as bad news.
Remachado como compuerta. Por aquí no pa: Riveted like a lock gate. Not even water gets through.
Pesa como una esclusa pequeña. Lo que ch: Heavy as a small lock. Whatever hits it waits its turn.
Cabo de barco anudado como manda la mari: Ship's rope knotted the way seamanship demands.
Suela de goma; no resbalan ni en el muel: Rubber soles; they won't slip even on a wet dock.
Lo perdió un pirata en Bocas; lo encontr: A pirate lost it in Bocas; the storm found it.
Moneda vieja doblada en aro. Atrae lo qu: An old coin bent into a band. It draws in whatever shines.
Cada perla, una inmersión de las que no: Each pearl, a dive nobody talks about.
Asta larga y punta de nácar. Frío como e: A long shaft with a mother-of-pearl tip. Cold as the sea floor.
La luz baila en ella y despista al que a: Light dances on it and throws attackers off.
Coral muerto, cosido con paciencia de pe: Dead coral, sewn with a fisher's patience.
Corta el aire antes que la carne; el tru: It cuts the air before the flesh; the thunder comes after.
Heavy as luck that never arrives.
Lo dejó un gigante del páramo. Hacen fal: A giant of the páramo left it behind. It takes two hands and a lot of faith.
Cuero curtido que huele a monte y a pris: Tanned leather that smells of the bush and of hurry.
Lana gruesa contra el viento que baja de: Thick wool against the wind coming down from the mountains.
Rama mojada que nunca se seca. Llora cua: A wet branch that never dries. It weeps when used.
Quien lo lleva oye llanto en el río. Mej: Whoever wears it hears weeping in the river. Better not to ask.
It always drips, even when it isn't raining.
Frío como el agua de la quebrada a media: Cold as ravine water at midnight.
Una medalla vieja que apareció en el fon: An old medal that turned up at the bottom of the river.
Dicen que el chofer fantasma la dejó en: They say the ghost driver left it at the bus stop. It doesn't honk, but it cuts.
Mira la ciudad desde arriba y la ciudad: It watches the city from above, and the city feels watched.
Destilada con agua de la quebrada. Levan: Distilled with ravine water. It would raise someone dead tired.
It shines only when nobody is looking.
Acero honrado a precio honrado. Lo que m: Honest steel at an honest price. Whatever you sell me, I'll keep a while in case you change your mind.
¿Heridas, cansancio, curiosidad? Tengo f: Wounds, weariness, curiosity? I have bottles for all three.
El Charco de la Garza está al suroeste,: Heron Pond is to the southwest, past the apothecary. If the float trembles, don't pull: wait until it sinks all the way.
Mira lo que saqué del agua…: Look what I pulled out of the water…
Clic en el agua, o la F mirando a la ori: Click the water, or press F facing the shore. When something bites you have a heartbeat to click. Rushing scares the fish.
¡Un pez linterna! Brillan de noche bajo: A lanternfish! They glow at night under the lily pads. Keep it safe: someone in the village would pay well for it.
Una bota vieja… La perdió mi primo hace: An old boot… My cousin lost it two summers ago. You can keep it; he already bought new ones.
Alto. Ah, eres de los que vienen a ayuda: Halt. Ah, you're one of those who come to help. Well, there's no shortage of work: the roads are worse than ever.
Satos al norte, duendes al este y un cur: Mutts to the north, duendes to the east and a healer who raises bones. There are three of us guarding the whole plain.
El camino del norte vuelve a ser transit: The north road is passable again thanks to you. The cart drivers drink to your health.
Me han dicho que el anciano te manda rec: I was told the elder sends his regards.
Siempre. Pero lo que de verdad me quita: Always. But what really keeps me up at night, old Celso knows better than I do.
¿Recuerdos? Ese viejo me debe tres parti: Regards? That old man owes me three games of dice. Tell him I haven't forgotten.
Siéntate, siéntate. A mi edad las visita: Sit, sit. At my age a visit is more welcome than bread.
¿Qué sabéis del viento del este?: What do you know about the east wind?
¿Por qué la sargento os reclama unos dad: Why is the sergeant after you about some dice?
Que trae duendes y algo más viejo que el: That it brings duendes and something older than them. Whoever learns to bend the wind can push it off their path.
Eso es cosa para piernas más curtidas. V: That's for more seasoned legs. Come back when you've seen a bit more of the world.
¡Ja! Porque hace trampas. Pero no se lo: Ha! Because she cheats. But don't tell her; I like beating her.
He oído que los satos ya no bajan al cam: I hear the mutts don't come down to the road anymore.
Lo he oído, sí. Y he visto tu hoja: tráe: I heard that, yes. And I've seen your blade: bring it to me when it chips and I'll make it like new. Well… someday.
I want to see your wares.
I'm looking for something for old Celso.
¿Otra vez las rodillas? Un tónico de rec: His knees again? A resource tonic will do him good. You get the usual price, which is still expensive.
Bienvenido a Iguanera. Aquí se viene a a: Welcome to Iguanera. People come here to learn the sea and the bush before crossing over. I look after the island; Nena runs the boat.
¿Cómo me oriento?: How do I find my way?
La M abre el mapa y la N, el diario con: M opens the map and N your quest journal. The Painted Stone right here is your spot: if you fall, you wake up beside it.
Las espirales siguen ahí, mirando al con: The spirals are still there, facing the mainland. If you find more, remember this island.
La lancha sale cuando Don Eligio diga qu: The boat leaves when Don Eligio says you're ready. Until then, there's work to do.
A Pedasol, en tierra firme. De allí sale: To Pedasol, on the mainland. The road to Villa Raspadura starts there.
Cuando quieras cruzamos. Haz clic junto: We cross whenever you like. Click by the dock to board. And if you ever want to come back, the other boat waits for you in Pedasol.
Un zorro de pelaje gris que muerde con b: A grey-furred fox that bites with embers.
Cataloga todo lo que brilla y te lo trae: It catalogs everything that shines and brings it to you.
Slow and patient; its moss heals.
Gathers wood from the trees on the map.
Recoge fibras de las plantas y destila e: Gathers fibers from plants and distills at the still.
Levels up by fishing at schools of fish.
Confecciona todo lo equipable que no sea: Makes all equipment that isn't a weapon or shield.
Marina Junco no puede pescar hoy y en la: Marina Junco can't fish today and the inn is waiting for perch. Fish at Heron Pond and bring her two silver perch.
Me he torcido la muñeca y la posada me p: I've twisted my wrist and the inn wants perch for dinner. Up for it? The pond is to the southwest. Three catches, and bring me two perch.
¿Ya pican? Las percas son las plateadas,: Are they biting yet? The perch are the silver ones with short fins.
¡Qué buenas! Toma, por las molestias. Y: Lovely ones! Here, for your trouble. And keep whatever else you catch: the pond belongs to everyone.
A pack prowls the northwest road. Sergeant Odila Brezo asks you to bring down three mutts and return two fangs as proof.
Una manada se ha instalado junto al cami: A pack has settled by the northwest road and the cart drivers won't pass. Bring down three mutts and bring me two fangs; the mayor trusts nobody.
Los satos siguen ahí, ¿no? Se les oye de: The mutts are still there, aren't they? You can hear them at night.
Dos colmillos, bien afilados. Buen traba: Two fangs, nice and sharp. Good work. This is from the guard; let no one say we don't pay.
Odila quiere saber si la vieja piedra de: Odila wants to know if the old lookout stone east of the village is still standing. Go and see it, then tell old Celso Musgo, who was a lookout in his youth.
Ya que tienes buenas piernas: al este ha: Since you've got good legs: to the east there's a stone where people used to watch over the plain. See if it's still standing and tell old Celso. He set it there.
La piedra del vigía, al este. No tiene p: The lookout stone, to the east. You can't miss it.
¿Sigue en pie? Ja, como yo. Gracias por: Still standing? Ha, like me. Thanks for coming to tell me: my legs don't carry me that far anymore.
A Celso Musgo le duelen las rodillas. Co: Celso Musgo's knees ache. Get him a resource tonic (the apothecary Tobías Cardo sells them) and a piece of leather for his knee brace.
Las rodillas, ya sabes. Tobías tiene un: The knees, you know. Tobías has a tonic that helps, and if you bring me a piece of leather I'll make myself a knee brace. Mutts drop it.
Tobías the apothecary sells the tonic. Any mutt has the leather.
Ah, mucho mejor. Te has portado. Vuelve: Ah, much better. You've done well. Come see me again: there's something I want to teach you.
Celso Musgo te enseñará a doblar el vien: Celso Musgo will teach you to bend the wind if you prove you can stand up to the duendes of the east.
El viento del este trae duendes. Si quie: The east wind brings duendes. If you want me to teach you to push them off your path, first show me you're not afraid of them. Three will do.
Three duendes. I ask no more.
Bien. Ahora escucha y mira mis manos: el: Good. Now listen and watch my hands: you don't push the wind, you go along with it… Like that. It's yours now.
Don Eligio Vergara cuida la isla. Acompa: Don Eligio Vergara looks after the island. Join his round: climb to the reef lookout, then greet Nena Cedeño, the boat skipper.
Buenos días. Antes de nada, una vuelta:: Good morning. Before anything else, a walk: click the ground to move and turn the camera with the right mouse button. Climb the northeast lookout and look at the reef. Then stop by the dock: Nena wants to meet you.
El mirador queda al noreste, pasadas las: The lookout is to the northeast, past the rocks. Press M to see the map.
Nena dice que tienes buena pinta para el: Nena says you look cut out for the sea. Coming from her, that's a lot.
Unos satos cimarrones rondan el muelle y: Some feral mutts prowl the dock and won't let Nena unload. Drive off three.
Los satos llegaron en una barca de pesca: The mutts came on a fishing boat and now think they own the dock. They're south of the clearing. Click one to attack it; your spells are on the bar below.
Si un sato se pone delante, gira y golpe: If a mutt gets in front of you, turn and strike. Don't let them surround you.
¡Por fin puedo descargar! Toma, para los: At last I can unload! Here, for the bruises.
Dos duendes tiran piedras desde el bosqu: Two duendes throw stones from the dry forest. Their throws are announced by a mark on the ground: step out of it in time.
Del monte del norte vuelan piedras. Son: Stones fly from the northern bush. They're rock-throwing duendes: before they throw, they mark the spot on the ground. When you see it, move aside; then get close and strike. Vigor drains when you run and cast: watch it.
Fíjate en la marca del suelo antes de ca: Watch for the mark on the ground before each throw.
Ni una piedra más. Has aprendido a leer: Not one more stone. You've learned to read the bush.
Nena no ha tenido tiempo de pescar. En l: Nena hasn't had time to fish. At the tide pool to the east, make two catches.
Con tanto sato no he pescado nada. En la: With all these mutts I haven't caught a thing. In the tide pool to the east there are trapped fish. Click the water and wait: when the float sinks, click again.
Paciencia: si tiras antes de que se hund: Patience: if you pull before it sinks, it gets away.
Con esto ceno yo y cenas tú. Lo demás qu: With this we both eat tonight. Anything else you catch is yours.
Con la marea baja han aparecido marcas e: With the low tide, marks have appeared on a rock to the south. A big mutt prowls there. Go see them and tell Don Eligio.
Con la marea baja salen marcas en la roc: At low tide, marks show up on the southern rock: spirals, like those on the Painted Stones, but without light. Go see them. Careful: a mutt bigger than the rest prowls there, and it isn't alone. Bring potions.
La roca del sur. Y cuidado con el sato g: The southern rock. And watch out for the big mutt.
¿Espirales que miran al continente? Mi a: Spirals facing the mainland? My grandmother said there are more inland. Nena will take you across to Pedasol whenever you like: that's where the road begins.
Golpe corto de tierra para rematar a un: A short earth strike to finish off a single enemy. No area to aim.
Apunta hacia donde quieres cargar: avanz: Aim where you want to charge: you dash forward, damaging and slightly pushing aside every enemy along the way.
An instant area strike around you. Use it after Charge when you end up surrounded.
Aumento fácil: durante 8 s ganas +20 de: Easy buff: for 8 s you gain +20 power and +10 physical resistance.
Lanza una brasa que marca al objetivo y: Throws an ember that marks the target and burns it for a few seconds.
Cubre el cuerpo de piedra y absorbe daño: Covers the body in stone and absorbs damage for 8 seconds.
Lanza una cadena al rojo que engancha al: Throws a red-hot chain that hooks the target and drags it to you.
Durante 6 s devuelves 60 % del daño de c: For 6 s you return 60% of the damage of each melee hit.
Proyectil básico: haz clic en un enemigo: Basic projectile: click an enemy. Cheap, no cooldown, and cast while walking.
Una lanza de hielo que atraviesa la fila: An ice lance that pierces the whole line and slows it.
Área alrededor de ti: daña e inmoviliza: Area around you: damages and roots anyone nearby so you can get away.
Se convierte en rayo y reaparece en el p: Turns into lightning and reappears at the chosen point.
Carga el suelo en el punto elegido; quie: Charges the ground at the chosen point; whoever steps on it is shocked every second.
Un abanico de rayos delante de la tejedo: A fan of lightning in front of the weaver; it sometimes stuns.
Un hilo de escarcha une a la tejedora co: A thread of frost links the weaver to her target: they swap places and the target is slowed.
Suelta una ráfaga de escarcha delante y: Releases a burst of frost ahead and leaps backward.
Una cúpula de estática devuelve al lanza: A dome of static sends spells aimed at the weaver back to their caster.
Aumento fácil: durante 8 s ganas +20 de: Easy buff: for 8 s you gain +20 power and +5% critical chance.
Pergamino de escarcha: un proyectil que: Frost scroll: a projectile that damages and slows one enemy. It can be learned earlier, but only goes on the bar from level 5.
Vendas de luz que cierran heridas y sigu: Bandages of light that close wounds and keep healing for a while.
La piel se cubre de roca: resiste mejor: The skin is covered in rock: it better resists physical and earth hits.
Llama a un lobo espectral que lucha a tu: Calls a spectral wolf that fights at your side for a few seconds.
Un golpe de viento en abanico que aparta: A fan-shaped blast of wind that pushes enemies away.
Marca este momento: al acabarse el eco v: Marks this moment: when the echo ends you return to where you were, with the health you had.
Un instante de piedra viva: nada te daña: A moment of living stone: nothing hurts or moves you, but you can't walk either.
Entierra una brasa invisible para los en: Buries an ember enemies can't see: when stepped on it bursts, pushing them back and leaving them weary.
Un golpe seco con la empuñadura: el sigu: A sharp blow with the hilt: the enemy's next spell takes longer or slips away.
Un abanico de aire helado que pesa en la: A fan of icy air that weighs on legs and hands: it wears out the enemies it hits.
Un silbido agudo que nubla el sentido de: A sharp whistle that clouds the sense of direction: the target can't use movement spells for a moment.
Pergamino: deja en el suelo un lazo invi: Scroll: leaves a snare on the ground that enemies can't see; whoever steps on it gets tangled.
Pergamino: un puñado de polvo que se peg: Scroll: a handful of dust that sticks to nearby hidden traps and reveals them for a while.
Loses health to fire every second.
Absorbs damage until depleted or expired.
Devuelve los hechizos de un objetivo a q: Sends single-target spells back to their caster.
Al acabarse, vuelve a donde estaba y con: When it ends, returns to where they were, with the health they had.
Inmune al daño, a los perjuicios y a los: Immune to damage, debuffs and knockbacks; cannot walk.
Pasos pesados y enfriamientos más lentos: Heavy steps and slower cooldowns. Stacks.
El próximo hechizo tarda más en salir o: The next spell takes longer to cast or is lost.
No sabe hacia dónde saltar: sin hechizos: Doesn't know where to leap: no movement spells.
Zafarse de un rival pegado cuesta: avanz: Breaking away from a clinging foe is hard: moves more slowly.
A jolt when pulling away from a foe.
La sueltan los satos, duendes y curander: Dropped by the mutts, duendes and healers of the Azuero Plains (lv. 1–10).
A dry whistle runs through the lime...
The light coughs; something scrapes the stone.
Asta de guayacán con punta de hierro. La: A guayacán shaft with an iron tip. Carried by those who guard the passage between the two seas.
Madera forrada de cuero con un ribete de: Leather-covered wood with a copper rim. It stands up to blows and downpours.
Arquero que pelea a distancia con flecha: Archer who fights at range with precise, explosive and cross-shaped arrows, and leaps back when cornered. Starts with a basic shot, a powder arrow and a buff; learns lines, crosses, controls and zones as he levels up.
Proyectil básico del arco: haz clic en u: Basic bow projectile: click an enemy. Cheap, no cooldown, and cast while walking.
Una flecha con carga de pólvora que esta: An arrow loaded with powder that bursts where it lands: damages everyone in a circle and leaves them burning.
Aumento fácil: durante 8 s ganas +18 de: Easy buff: for 8 s you gain +18 power and +8% critical chance.
Cuatro flechas caen en cruz sobre el pun: Four arrows fall in a cross on the chosen point: damages anyone on any of its arms.
Una flecha tensa al máximo que atraviesa: A fully drawn arrow that pierces everyone in a straight line.
Dispara a quemarropa hacia delante y sal: Fires point-blank ahead and leaps backward to gain distance.
Una flecha atada con bejuco que enreda a: An arrow tied with vine that tangles the target and pins it in place for a moment.
Una nube de flechas cae sobre una zona a: A cloud of arrows falls on a wide area and damages everyone beneath it.
